scope: Connected native host-event capability/error and accepted-request closure across shared readiness, TCP/retained sockets, stream/file waits, io_uring enter/CQ poll/background maintenance, source execution and elected idle executor.

architecture.authority: Original IoSignal weak target, HostEvents poller Result and wait-scoped original transport/OFD leases. Duplicate weak target fields in io_uring wait/background/poll actors are removed.
architecture.api: IoWake::host_events returns Result<Option<Arc<HostEvents>>>. Ok(None) is missing capability; Err is the original host error. IoSignal::subscribe_host shares that selection and original FD registration.
architecture.errors: Readiness retains the original creation/duplicate/attach/dynamic/registration failure, preserving kind, message and raw OS code when present. IoAttempt::HostError and RuntimeError::HostIo never fabricate a guest errno.
architecture.publication: The original Epoch publishes its first immutable Arc<io::Error> once through OnceLock. Normal guest execution gains no error mutex, memory fence or per-instruction check.
architecture.completion: Subscribe-before-retry remains. A ready/cancelled stale interest can finish without needing a native backend. Already completed guest effects are neither replayed nor rolled back.
architecture.cleanup: Source/idle executor stops and notifies actual CPU actors. After actor/View drain, accepted original task/mm io_uring requests cancel through existing CQ and dependency cleanup. There is no owner syscall pump or new service.
architecture.legacy: Capability-less bootstrap embeddings preserve their explicit route; terminal bootstrap now handles HostError explicitly rather than reaching its checkpoint-only assertion.

failure_injection.cpu_backend: Shared interpreter conformance with real native host TCP/event resources on both macOS and ARM64 Linux
assertions: Original host kind and message survive to HostIo.
Every actual CPU actor acknowledges stop; no owner service/VM dispatch event is required.
The failing SVC does not publish a fabricated x0, retire a syscall or execute its following marker.
The failed read/payload output remains untouched.
Accepted requests cancel, original CQ publishes exactly one ECANCELED, and owner_required stays false for backend failure.
Original TCP transport reaches final EOF after source capture/subscription release.
failure_injection.idle: A native producer appears after an ordinary eventfd parked. The elected existing idle executor reports original hub failure without losing its wake or requesting owner replay.

shared_regressions: Missing native capability is distinct from failed backend creation and does not acquire an FD.
Descriptor duplication, driver attach and dynamic source errors preserve their original cause.
Real registration ID exhaustion releases native FD/resource leases outside the registry lock through the shared source subscription API.
Repeated subscription rearm preserves the original raw OS code.
An accepted io_uring native request preserves its original identity after a failed backend; explicit retry completes once when ready, or cancellation leaves payload untouched.
Normal native rearm/alias/partial-read/EOF/cancellation and original source wait/lifecycle regressions remain passing.
validation_notes: Full workflows pass on immutable original-error ownership. A final explicit legacy terminal HostError arm is checked by the affected complete process suite, core lint and iPad compilation; unchanged full runtime/FFI results are reused. Linux records its prior workflow source hashes separately.
Initial new test setup used a wrong epoll helper/private Linux entry and fixed CQ offsets; it now uses the actual kernel entry and original CQ accessors before verification.
The injected backend cache is compiled only for interpreter conformance; production code has no injection branch.
limits: Native infrastructure failure terminates the current runtime run after original actor/request drain; no automatic coordinator/raw-poll recovery is added.
Ordinary filesystem/network operation errors retain their existing guest ABI.
Signed HVF/product regressions cover normal native execution; the new backend-failure injection runs in the shared interpreter suite, not an injected HVF machine.
No controlled throughput or total coordinator-removal claim is made.
Mac product development workflow steps 1-8 of 12 pass; release packaging steps are outside this Dev-only batch.
remaining: Actual host cancellation/deadline/shutdown and final backend/session teardown.
Genuine missing capabilities/excluded resources, including two io_uring wait-capability/body maintenance escalation call sites.
Initial/legacy admission and capability-less embedding orchestration; solo execution alone is not a cross-thread RPC.
